metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API — HIPAA GRC Baseline

components.title: acme-health-grc-baseline
components.description: GRC baseline layer wrapping the Acme Health Patient Intake API. Adds CMK encryption, TLS-only access, versioning, least-privilege IAM, audit logging, CloudTrail, and an immutable evidence vault. Closes GAP-01 through GAP-08 from GAPS.md.
components.purpose: Make the cgep-app-starter Patient Intake API audit-defensible under HIPAA Security Rule within 30 days without slowing the engineering team.

control-implementations.description: HIPAA Security Rule controls implemented via NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 mapping. Primary framework: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164).

implemented-requirements.description: PHI encrypted at rest using customer-managed KMS keys (CMK). S3 uploads bucket uses SSE-KMS via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration. DynamoDB submissions table uses CMK via server_side_encryption block. Closes GAP-01 and GAP-02. Maps to HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json and state.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Access enforcement via TLS-only bucket policy (aws:SecureTransport deny) and least-privilege IAM replacing dynamodb:* and s3:* wildcards with specific actions. Lambda security group allows only HTTPS egress. Closes GAP-03 and GAP-07. Maps to HIPAA 164.312(e)(1) and 164.312(a)(1).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json and state.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Audit records generated via CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation) and API Gateway access logging to CloudWatch. DLQ captures failed Lambda invocations. Closes GAP-06 and GAP-08. Maps to HIPAA 164.312(b).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json and state.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Configuration settings enforced via provider default_tags (Project, ManagedBy, ComplianceScope, DataClass on every resource), S3 versioning for PHI recovery, and KMS key rotation enabled. Closes GAP-04. Maps to HIPAA 164.308(a)(7).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json and state.json.
